CustomField.description: Controls divider display for the section. For Field Set sections it passes show-field-set-divider into c-flow-form, which draws the divider inside the form. For all OTHER component types the formTemplatePageSection LWC reads this flag (showSectionDivider) and draws a page-section-level divider via c-form-section-theme, positioned by Divider Position and styled by Divider Style/Title/Subtitle/Icon/Vertical Margin. Defaults to false.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to show a divider line for this section. Configure its look with the Divider Style, Title, Subtitle, Icon, Position, and Margin fields on the Divider tab.
CustomField.label: Show Divider
